content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Scientist - I: Ph. D in Engineering/Technology/Science or Master's degree in engineering or technology from a recognized university preferably in the area of Electronics/ Computer Science/ Mechanical/ Civil/ IT/ Agriculture or equivalent; and (ii) Three years' Research and Development experience in Industrial and Academic institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services or (iii) Bachelors in engineering or technology preferably in the area of Electronics/ Computer Science/ Mechanical/ Civil/ IT/ Agriculture with 10 years’ of relevant industrial experience. Project Associate - I: Master’s degree in natural or agriculture sciences/MVSc/ Engineering/ Technology preferably in the area of Electronics/ Computer Science/ Mechanical/ Civil/ IT/ Agriculture or equivalent, or Bachelors in engineering or technology preferably in the area of Electronics/ Computer Science/ Mechanical/ Civil/ IT/ Agriculture or Medicine from a recognized university or equivalent. Field Worker: Bachelors in any discipline from a recognized university or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the IIT Guwahati recruitment is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Project Scientist - I, Project Associate - I, and Field Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Scientist - I post?
faq.answer: For the Project Scientist - I position, candidates need a Ph. D in Engineering/Technology/Science or a Master's degree in engineering or technology with relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree in engineering or technology with 10 years of industrial experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Worker position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 22850.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts at IIT Guwahati will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati, Assam, 781039.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly provided in the extracted data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Guwahati.
